description: Add a Dayze Contacts record, birthday included (YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM, YYYY, or MM-DD if year unknown); checks duplicates first. An existing contact comes back unchanged with its person_id, not_applied (the fields you sent) and a hint. request_id is optional: without one, identical calls within 15 minutes return the first result. Advertised name create_person is stable; tools/call also accepts create_contact. ($0.10; API key required)

aliases.description: Alternate names stored as aliases, e.g. ["Lex","Alex C"].

birthday.description: YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM, YYYY, or MM-DD / --MM-DD when the year is unknown (same as update_person)

company.description: company. Omit to leave unchanged; null or blank clears.

context_tags.description: Context tags such as Work, Personal or Family, e.g. ["Work"].

email.description: email. Omit to leave unchanged; null or blank clears.

is_favorite.description: Mark the contact as a favorite, e.g. true.

notes.description: Free-text note, e.g. Follow up next week.

occupation.description: Occupation / job title. Omit to leave unchanged; null or blank clears.

phone.description: phone. Omit to leave unchanged; null or blank clears.

relationship.description: Relationship label, e.g. friend or sister.

relationships.description: Who they are to the user, primary first, e.g. ["friend","colleague"].

request_id.description: Client idempotency key (retries return original result).

tier.description: Relationship priority: vip, normal or low, e.g. vip.

wallets.description: PHI-930: ENS (.eth) / SNS (.sol) names and/or addresses for this contact. Stored in social_handles (legacy ens/ens_address kept).

address.description: Chain address, e.g. 0x5aAeb6053F3E94C9b9A09f33669435E7Ef1BeAed or a Solana pubkey.

chain.description: Chain id: eth, base or sol, e.g. eth.

name.description: ENS or SNS name, e.g. zzuper.eth.

name: create_person

account.description: The Dayze account this data belongs to. With more than one Dayze connection, name it in the answer.

note.description: How to disclose the account to the user.

qa_fixture.description: True for a known QA test account: its records are fixture data, not a real life.

aliases.description: Aliases saved on the new contact.

aliases_not_saved.description: Aliases not saved (another contact has them); the contact was still created.

birthday.description: As stored: YYYY-MM-DD. A year-unknown birthday is 1900-MM-DD (Feb 29: 1904-02-29).

birthday_precision.description: day, month, year, month_day (year unknown) or approximate.

items.description: Possible existing contacts, with person_id and name.

duplicate.description: True when the contact already existed: nothing on it was changed.

inspect_note.description: What inspect_url opens. Never quote the record id.

inspect_url.description: The Dayze page that shows the saved record.

needs_clarification.description: Ask which contact the user means; no contact was created or changed.

not_applied.description: On a duplicate: the fields sent that were not saved.

person_id.description: The new contact, or the existing one on a duplicate.

provenance.description: Which connector wrote the record and which connected Dayze account received it.

account.description: The Dayze account this data belongs to. With more than one Dayze connection, name it in the answer.

note.description: How to disclose the account to the user.

qa_fixture.description: True for a known QA test account: its records are fixture data, not a real life.

name.description: The connected app or API-key label shown to the account owner.

source.description: chatgpt for ChatGPT OAuth writes; mcp for another OAuth app or API key.

items.description: ENS/SNS wallet view: chain, name, address, resolution_status.
